subject.title: fix: resolve Codex fork duplication when parent is unresolved (#2108)

question: After the two current-head defects and proof gap are resolved, should the fork-accounting fix land through this PR, through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118, or through a consolidated branch containing both complementary behaviors?
rationale: Both open PRs modify overlapping scanner identity and cache invariants, while the merged baseline deliberately deferred full cross-file provenance; choosing the canonical implementation and merge order requires ownership of the accounting compatibility boundary.

options.title: Consolidate both fixes
options.body: Adopt leaf-session and parent-baseline handling from the overlapping PR together with this PR's reliable row-level fork ownership, complete cross-window invalidation, and focused regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Land only this PR's unresolved-parent row-provenance behavior after fixing its blockers and proving that the separate identity and parent-baseline cases remain correctly handled.

options.title: Prefer the other PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 as the landing branch and port any unique unresolved-parent sibling-deduplication coverage needed from this PR before closing it.

recommendation.title: Consolidate both fixes
recommendation.body: Adopt leaf-session and parent-baseline handling from the overlapping PR together with this PR's reliable row-level fork ownership, complete cross-window invalidation, and focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available owner for selecting the canonical implementation and accepting the historical-accounting upgrade behavior.
